title: Commons: Mute and unmute a chat or group
goal: Allow characters (and the UI) to mute and unmute individual Commons DMs, groups, or #public channels

sections.what: Add per-character channel muting/unmuting in The Commons across engine, routes, agent tools, prompt context, and UI.
sections.why: Characters in DMs, groups, or #public need a way to silence noisy or unwanted chats without blocking the person globally or leaving a channel, and auto-reply should respect muted state.
sections.how: Store per-character muted channel IDs in Commons state, add POST /api/commons/channels/<id>/mute, expose mute_chat/unmute_chat tools in CommonsAgent, annotate muted channels in buildCommunicationPrompt, and skip muted recipients in triggerAutoReplyForChannel.
sections.verify: pytest tests/test_commons.py -q and npm run build:ts

acceptance.text: engine/commons.py and routes/commons.py persist per-character muted channel state and expose a mute/unmute endpoint
CommonsAgent exposes mute_chat / unmute_chat tool in communicationTools and executeCommunicationTool
Auto-reply on message and unread wakeups skip muted channels for that character while still allowing manual Act or unmute
buildCommunicationPrompt indicates [muted] on muted channels and Commons UI shows mute state + toggle

custom.browser_ui: In /commons, show a mute/unmute toggle on each channel/DM header or row and a muted indicator badge; muted channels skip auto-reply on incoming messages while still allowing manual Act or unmuting.
